note: Mutants of the delay of a live match's snapshot for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): a match with two or more people is shown 30 seconds late, counted from the seats when the match begins, and the recorder cuts the snapshot there (RP8.3 of test_replay). Run from the checkout with a configured build folder: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/live_delay_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1. Every mutant must be caught.
